attributes.board_name: West Virginia Board of Examiners for Speech-Language Pathology and Audiology

rules.accepted_credit_types: Credits issued by ASHA, the West Virginia Speech-Language-Hearing Association or the American Academy of Audiology, or activities approved by the Board (prior approval needed for other organizations); online courses accepted if from these organizations. Presenters may count 1.5 times the workshop length the first time it is presented. College teaching in communication disorders/audiology does not count.
rules.new_licensee_rule: Persons initially licensed during the last six months of the two-year licensing period need no CE for the first renewal.
rules.carryover: Up to 6 hours above the minimum may be carried to the next reporting period only.
rules.audit_note: Attest on the renewal application; keep CE documents 4 years. The Board may audit after every two-year cycle (randomly selected licensees notified by certified mail, 30 days to respond); audit results are published on the Board website.

topics.who: All licensees: 1 clock hour of approved ethics per year (2 per two-year period)

rules.legal_basis: W. Va. Code St. R. §29-1-14 (29CSR1, effective May 1, 2022); W. Va. Code ch. 30, art. 32
rules.notes: Licenses expire biennially on Dec 31 of even years. 20 clock hours per two-year period incl. 2 hours ethics. Dual SLP + audiology licensees: 15 clock hours in each area (30 total). Provisional licensees: 10 hours in the provisional license year. Licensees offering telepractice must also have 20 hours of telepractice-specific CE (one-time, §29-1-16).
rules.rule_quote: 14.2. A professional licensee shall obtain a minimum of 20 clock hours of continuing education during every two-year licensure period.

rules.accepted_credit_types: Board-approved CE in the assistant's field, earned between registration and expiration date; proof of attendance required.
rules.audit_note: The supervising licensee renews the assistant's registration; the assistant must provide proof of attendance for all activities claimed.
rules.legal_basis: W. Va. Code St. R. §29-2-9 (29CSR2, effective April 30, 2025)
rules.notes: Assistants are registered by their supervisor for up to one year; registrations expire Dec 31 each year. Renewal requires 5 hours of Board-approved CE in the previous year incl. 1 clock hour of ethics.
rules.rule_quote: 9.2.1. The assistant has completed (5) hours of Board approved continuing education in his or her field during the previous year.
